context: Extract the duplicated tray markup into one component consumed by both pages, then add: (1) padding-bottom: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) via a --bb-inset-bottom token; (2) a trailing spacer or scroll-padding-bottom on the table container sized to the tray's MEASURED height, since expanded and collapsed heights differ; (3) a minimal @media print rule hiding the tray. Full print support is rx-ux-20; this item only stops the tray printing over content.
description:
Two near-identical fixed selection trays already ship: BenchmarkIndex.tsx:781 and PlatformIndex.tsx:793, both `fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 border-t ... shadow-lg`. Neither has a bottom inset nor last-row clearance, so the final table row sits under the tray. There is no @media print rule anywhere in the Explorer, so both trays print over content on every page.

This is a CURRENT defect on shipped UI, not preparation for future work. It is scheduled in Phase 1 for that reason.

Note on safe-area: index.html:23 does not set `viewport-fit=cover`, so env(safe-area-inset-bottom) resolves to 0 today. Home-indicator overlap is therefore NOT established. Introduce the inset as a token seam (--bb-inset-bottom) with a documented default of 0; adopting viewport-fit=cover is a separate global layout decision and is out of scope here.

anti_patterns.dont: adopt viewport-fit=cover as a side effect
anti_patterns.instead: leave the inset seam inert and raise viewport-fit as its own decision
anti_patterns.why: it changes layout globally for every route

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

anti_patterns.dont: make the tray a sticky child of a table's overflow-x-auto container
anti_patterns.instead: keep it fixed at desktop and give it its own containing block
anti_patterns.why: those containers are horizontal scrollers and the app uses document scrolling (Layout.tsx:19); a sticky child would track horizontal offset

anti_patterns.dont: regenerate the public-site visual baseline inside the PR
anti_patterns.instead: name which e2e/captures specs the change invalidates and update those deliberately
anti_patterns.why: the baseline is an external CI artifact tied to a base SHA, not a checked-in snapshot

anti_patterns.dont: rely on scroll-padding-bottom alone for clearance
anti_patterns.instead: add real trailing space sized to the measured tray height
anti_patterns.why: scroll-padding only affects scroll-target alignment, not resting content overlap

preserves.behavior: Disabled reasons are exposed via aria-describedby (PlatformIndex.tsx:961, Query.tsx:900), not an accessible-name suffix. Follow the shipped pattern.
Existing tray behaviour and copy on both pages; this is a layout and de-duplication change only
Sticky first columns already exist: MetaLeaderboard.tsx:273-280 (Platform) and QueryHeatmap.tsx:669-732 (four frozen columns). Do not re-add them.
